select_rows_by_field_values: select rows from a SQLite table by matching multiple field names against lists of values
serialize_table_data: serialize database table rows by converting datetime fields ending in _at or _date to ISO format strings
export_db_to_dict: export all Mephisto database tables to a dictionary with serialized data for backup or migration
export_task_runs_to_dict: export a partial Mephisto database filtered by task run IDs including related agents assignments and workers
apply_db_migrations: apply SQL migrations to a Mephisto database tracking completed and errored migration status in a migrations table
